title: task edit cannot unset a priority: --priority "" stores an empty string instead of clearing the field
description: Found 2026-10-28 while reverting QCLI-251 during the QCLI-538 grooming (record: QCLI-538 notes). QCLI-251 had no priority key. `quest task edit QCLI-251 --priority medium` set one, and `quest task edit QCLI-251 --priority ""` then stored `"priority":""` rather than removing the key; `task view` read it back as an empty string, not null. There is no clear-priority flag (compare --clear-milestone, --clear-parent). The only way back to the original record was `git checkout <ref> -- <file>`, which bypasses quest. CORRECTED 2026-10-29 (review of #691): the earlier claim here that quest doctor would report the empty string was false at source -- vocabularyDrift skips an empty value (src/domain/tasks/vocabulary.ts), and resolveVocabularyValue documents an empty value as the clear, so doctor stays silent about it. Reproduce against `bun src/cli/main.ts` before fixing, per the installed-vs-dev rule.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A priority set on a task can be cleared through quest, so task view reads it as null and the stored record has no priority key
An empty-string --priority is either refused with a validation error naming the clear path or treated as that clear, and the choice is stated in help
The new behavior has a test in both directions: a set-then-clear round trip, and the empty-string case

implementationNotes: Fix: foldEditPatch (src/application/tasks/edit-patch.ts) maps an empty --priority to undefined, matching resolveVocabularyValue's documented "an empty value clears the field". Chose this over a new --clear-priority flag: no new flag means no manifest, contract or tracker-client surface change. Help text and CHANGELOG state it. --type "" has the same shape and is NOT changed here (out of this task's criteria); say so if it should be filed. Test test/qcli539-clear-priority.test.ts fails 2 of 3 without the src change (verified by stashing it), passes with it. test/qcli330, 283, 297 and test/contract pass; biome lint and format clean; tsc clean.

AC2 amended 2026-10-29 from "stated in the manifest and help" to "stated in help", per opum-doc ruling A on ODOC-480 (13:56Z note): the manifest carries flag value shape only (QCLI-266), and adding prose to it is a manifest contract change outside this task. B (an additive manifest statement, precedent QCLI-313) is not ruled out for later and would be its own task. My earlier note that this change needed no manifest change was a gap against the AC as written, not a rationale; the reviewer (DEC-183, quest-cli-review-1) was right to block on it. Also folded in review follow-ups 6 and 7 as test-only/wording fixes: the doctor assertion in test 2 was vacuous (vocabularyDrift skips "") and is removed, test 1 now asserts the key absent from task view and null under --fields, an edit-batch test makes the changelog claim true, and the help sentence now says task edit (not "an empty value") never stores an empty priority.
